top_signal.title: Do I stay or buy out need actually advice and what you would do as a business owner
top_signal.summary: TLDR: 24 m owns 10% restaurant with family doesn’t get listened to with any problems by uncle and cousin they show that they don’t care. I was “striped” from authority to tell workers on the other hand has to deal with anything owner like anything I bring to table is ignored does most of the of work while others play golf. Bad food and service but also blamed because i “don’t care” don’t get paid when I’m there did revert to waiting tables when there and always slow cause no one wants to come back. Workers that don’t wanna listen also can’t tell them anything cause I’m a “dictator” and a “chef” that doesn’t know how to cook steak. Honestly what would you do need actual advice   Keeping the restaurant  Pros:  Got 10%  Could be something good for future  Got a vision and idea of what could be  Loves what I do    Cons:  Ignored by partners  Does all the inventory and day to day problem solving  Always at restaurant while other owners play golf  No authority can’t say anything (I’m to mean)  Don’t treat me as a owner    Uncle  Pros:  Good at what he does  Knows the industry a lot more than I do  Has the money  Taught me everything  Good judgment and decision making  Cons:  Never here / wants to retire  Don’t see me as an equal  Gives favoritism to chef and family    Cousin  Pros:  Could help  Good when applies herself  Can be useful when needed  Cons  Never there  Has a spoiled and massive ego works off ego  Closed minded not her idea not a good one  Lazy when it comes to any typ
